_note: Ratios: WCAG 2.x via colorjs.io, alpha composited over the surface. Tag rubric = an existing sk-design-sys rubric line; proposed = a check the rubric lacks. Decoys must not be reported as failing. Neutral items score neither way.

must.what: dark: --text-muted (#5b6170) fails on dark --bg (3.14:1) and/or dark --surface (2.86:1)
--text-placeholder rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4) fails on --surface in light (2.85:1 after compositing)
--text-placeholder is not redefined for dark, so black 40% on the dark surface is nearly invisible (about 1.1:1)
white label on --danger #ef4444 fails (3.76:1) in .btn-danger
--danger used as .error-text fails on surface in light (3.76:1)
dark: white --primary-fg on dark --primary #3b82f6 fails (3.68:1)
dark: white label on dark --danger #f87171 fails (2.77:1)
off-scale spacing: .card padding 14px and/or .btn-primary padding 10px are not on the --space scale
hover colors are per-variant hard-coded (--blue-700, #dc2626) rather than one rule
the accent/primary is reused for a second meaning (badge-new also used for info notices)

decoys.what: --text-muted #6b7280 on light --bg passes (4.62:1) and on --surface (4.83:1); reporting it as failing 4.5:1 is wrong
white on light --primary #2563eb passes 4.5:1 (5.17:1); calling it a 4.5:1 failure is wrong (citing the 7:1 brand-text target is fine)
dark --danger #f87171 as text on dark surface passes (6.41:1)
the dark theme exists; saying there is no dark theme is wrong

must.what: dark: color.text-subtle (gray.600 #52525b) fails on dark bg (2.57:1) and/or dark bg-subtle (2.29:1)
near-duplicate colors: bg-subtle #fafafa vs surface-raised #f9f9f9 (identical in dark), or border #e4e4e7 vs divider #e5e5e6
caption typography uses fontWeight 300 at 12px (no weight under 400 below about 28px)
body typography lineHeight 1.2 is too tight for wrapped text (needs about 1.4 or more)
color.action-purple is named by its value (purple), not its role
no error/danger color role

decoys.what: light text-subtle #71717a passes on bg (4.83:1) and bg-subtle (4.63:1)
focus violet.500 passes 3:1 on bg in light (4.23:1)
a dark mode exists (via $extensions.mode.dark); saying there is none is wrong

must.what: on-primary white on primary #f59e0b fails (2.15:1)
captions #9ca3af on surface (stated only in the prose) fail (2.54:1)
focus indicator is 1px and the outline color #d1d5db is 1.47:1 on surface (needs at least 2px and 3:1)
dark mode is a plain inversion / not designed (dark must be tuned, not inverted)
cards use 20px padding, which is not on the spacing scale (4, 8, 16, 24, 40)
hover is per-color darkening by 10% rather than one overlay rule

decoys.what: on-surface-variant #6b7280 passes on surface (4.83:1)

must.what: --text-muted dimgray fails on bg black (3.83:1) and/or surface #121212 (3.41:1)

must.what: says the file is malformed / invalid / truncated JSON

decoys.what: reports values or tokens that do not appear in the file (anything after accent), or presents a complete audit as if the file were whole
